embedding.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

nodes.name: additive contamination
nodes.def: Low-energy pollution, including pileup and the underlying event, which adds low-energy particles to an event

nodes.name: angular ordering
nodes.def: A property of radiation patterns in QCD, encoding coherence effects, in which subsequent emissions occur (approximately) at decreasing angles

nodes.name: asymptotic freedom
nodes.def: A phenomenon of certain quantum field theories, first observed in QCD, in which the interactions of particles at high energies become weaker and weaker, and particles at infinite energy are completely free of interactions.

nodes.name: jet algorithm
nodes.def: An algorithm which determines which subset of final state particles are grouped into a jet

nodes.name: confinement
nodes.def: The phenomenon of QCD where quarks and gluons are permanently bound within composite hadrons, and cannot be isolated as free particles

nodes.name: limit
nodes.def: A kinematic regime in which the momenta of two or more particles become nearly parallel

nodes.name: safety
nodes.def: A property of observables whose outcome remains unchanged when a particle splits into two exactly collinear particles with the same total momentum

nodes.name: constituent subtraction (CS)
nodes.def: A pileup mitigation technique which subtracts from the momenta of particles in an event. See pileup mitigation
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: continuity
nodes.def: A property of functions for which small changes in input produce small changes in output

nodes.name: continuous grooming
nodes.def: Jet grooming procedures that remove soft radiation while ensuring that small changes to input jets produce small changes in groomed output

nodes.name: uniform continuity
nodes.def: A property of continuous functions for which the degree of continuity is consistent across the entire domain, not varying with the specific location.
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: coupling constant
nodes.def: A number describing the strength of interactions between particles

nodes.name: frozen coupling
nodes.def: A phenomenological model of non-perturbative QCD effects in which the effective value of ( _s ) is fixed below an appropriately chosen scale.

nodes.name: cross section
nodes.def: A measure of the probability for a specific interaction between particles.

nodes.name: de-clustering
nodes.def: The process of reversing a jet clustering algorithm to reveal the sequence of pairwise splittings that formed the jet
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: detector effects (experimental)
nodes.def: Distortions and uncertainties in experimental data introduced by the limited resolution of experimental detectors and the interactions of experimental detectors with final-state particles

nodes.name: Dokshitzer-Gribov-Lipatov-Altarelli-Parisi (DGLAP)
nodes.def: Physicists who contributed deeply to foundational results of perturbative QCD, including those that bear their names.

nodes.name: equation
nodes.def: Integro-differential equations that govern the evolution of the distribution of partons within composite objects as a function of energy scale

nodes.name: splitting function
nodes.def: Functions governing the pseudo-probability distribution for a parton to split into two partons with given momentum fractions

nodes.name: reduced
nodes.def: A splitting function ( p (z) = p(z) + p(1-z) ), with (z 1/2 ), designed for calculations sensitive to the softer branch of a partonic splitting
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: differential cross section
nodes.def: The contribution of a particular kinematic region to a total cross section

nodes.name: discontinuity
nodes.def: A point where a function undergoes a large change in output despite a small change in input. % Also see continuity
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: angular
nodes.def: A discontinuity that arises from small changes in the angles of outgoing particles

nodes.name: plus-regularized
nodes.def: A regularization of a parent function (a plus-function) that removes singularities and ensures integrability; % in particular, a plus-function integrates to zero

nodes.name: emission
nodes.def: Particles radiated during the evolution of a high-energy parton. Forms the basic building block of parton showers and QCD jet formation

nodes.name: critical
nodes.def: In grooming, the first emission to survive a grooming procedure
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: pre-critical
nodes.def: Emissions which are wider in angle than a critical emission
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: subsequent
nodes.def: Emissions which are narrower in angle than a critical emission

nodes.name: energy-weighted correlations
nodes.def: A class of observables which measure correlations in an event weighted by the energies of contributing particles

nodes.name: Energy-Energy Correlator (EEC)
nodes.def: An observable measuring the correlation between particles in an event separated at specific angles

nodes.name: Projected N-Point Energy Correlator (PENC)
nodes.def: An observable with a single argument which measures angular correlations between (N ) particles; % reproduces the EEC when (N=2 )

nodes.name: Resolved N-Point Energy Correlator (RENC)
nodes.def: An obserable measuring angular correlations between (N ) particles which depends on more than one argument, resolving more information than PENCs

nodes.name: energy flow
nodes.def: The outgoing distribution of energy in a particle collision experiment. % In the massless limit, can be formulated in terms of quantum operators

nodes.name: Energy Mover's Distance (EMD)
nodes.def: A metric on the space of final states of a particle collision, which may be thought of as the amount of ``work'' required to rearrange one event into another
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: FastJet
nodes.def: A software package implementing jet finding algorithms and related tools

nodes.name: factorization
nodes.def: When a quantity (such as an amplitude or differential cross section) can be expressed in terms of simpler, independent components as a product or sum of products

nodes.name: of collinear phase space
nodes.def: A decomposition of phase space distributions in the collinear limit which separates collinear singularities from regular, well-behaved pieces

nodes.name: eikonal
nodes.def: A factorization of amplitudes or phase space in the limit where two particles (i ) and (j ) are nearly collinear, and obey (p_i p_j p_ p_m ) for all ( ) and (m )

nodes.name: fragmentation
nodes.def: A process describing how a single high-energy object fragments into multiple pieces in a particle collision; % often used to refer to the non-perturbative fragmentation of partons into hadrons

nodes.name: parton-to-parton fragmentation function
nodes.def: A function describing the probability for a parton to contain another parton with a given energy fraction at a different energy scale

nodes.name: grid median background estimation (GMBE)
nodes.def: A technique for estimating the amount of additive contamination in an event. % See PU mitigation
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: hadron
nodes.def: A composite particle made of quarks and gluons bound by the strong force, including baryons formed by three quarks (like protons and neutrons) and mesons formed by quark-antiquark pairs (like pions)

nodes.name: hadron-level
nodes.def: Observables or analyses defined in terms of final state hadrons

nodes.name: hadronization
nodes.def: A theoretical procedure for converting paron-level results into hadron-level results

nodes.name: hard cutoff grooming algorithm
nodes.def: A jet grooming algorithm that applies a sharp threshold criterion to remove soft radiation

nodes.name: subjet
nodes.def: A jet-like structure within an existing jet, formed by applying a jet definition with a smaller radius, which can be used to encode the fractal-like inner structure of jets

nodes.name: definition
nodes.def: A concrete algorithm for determining the particles and properties of a jet. % Determined by a jet algorithm and a recombination scheme

nodes.name: jet calculus
nodes.def: A early theoretical framework for calculating the evolution of parton distributions within jets

nodes.name: jet grooming
nodes.def: Techniques for removing low-energy contamination from jets while preserving the hard structure originating from an initial parton

nodes.name: constant cutoff
nodes.def: A toy grooming algorithm that removes radiation below a certain energy-fraction threshold from a tree of jet emissions

nodes.name: constant subtraction
nodes.def: A toy grooming algorithm which subtracts a fixed energy fraction from jet constituents within a tree of jet emissions

nodes.name: modified Mass Drop Tagger (mMDT)
nodes.def: A jet groomer preceding Soft Drop, and identical to Soft Drop with ( _ SD =1 )
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: PIRANHA
nodes.def: A paradigm for continuous jet grooming based on optimal transport and event geometry
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: P-AS
nodes.def: A Piranha groomer which removes soft radiation through the geometry of Apollonius diagrams
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: Iterated Voronoi Subtraction (P-IVS)
nodes.def: A Piranha groomer which iteratively removes soft radiation through the geometry of Voronoi diagrams
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: Recursive Subtraction (P-RS)
nodes.def: A tree-based Piranha groomer which recursively loops through an angular-ordered tree of jet emissions
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: P-RSF
nodes.def: An implementation of P-RS which subtracts a specified fraction of radiation from the softer branch of each splitting in a jet tree
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: Soft Drop (SD)
nodes.def: A two-parameter family of hard-cutoff jet groomers
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: jet substructure
nodes.def: The internal features of a jet that arise from the fragmentation of high-energy partons

nodes.name: substructure diagram
nodes.def: A diagram of the energy-fraction/angle ( ( (z)- ( ) )) plane which can be used in analytic calculations

nodes.name: Mellin transform
nodes.def: An integral transform which extracts the different scaling components of a function

nodes.name: multiple parton interactions (MPI)
nodes.def: A parton-level model for the underlying event of proton-proton collisions, in which UE is formed by interactions of several relatively low-energy partonic consituents of the proton. % See UE

nodes.name: collider observable
nodes.def: A map from a set of particle momenta to a specified target space, such as a real number (e.g. jet mass) or a distribution (e.g. the EEC)

nodes.name: additive observable
nodes.def: A jet substructure observable whose value can be expressed as a sum over emissions within the jet: (F( jet ) = _ i jet f(z_i, _i) ).

nodes.name: angularity
nodes.def: An additive collider observable which is roughly the sum of contributions of the form (z_i _i^ )

nodes.name: generalized energy correlation function (GECF)
nodes.def: A collider observable which is roughly the sum of contributions of the form (z_i z_j _ ij ^ ) over all pairs of particles in a jet

nodes.name: energy-weighted
nodes.def: See energy-weighted correlations

nodes.name: non-global
nodes.def: An observable depending only on a subset of particles within a scattering event. % Includes jet-substructure observables

nodes.name: parton
nodes.def: A roughly non-interacting, point-like particle

nodes.name: partonic cascade
nodes.def: A tree-like structure formed by a series of recursive decays of a parent parton

nodes.name: parton-level
nodes.def: Observables or analyses defined in terms of ``final-state'' partons

nodes.name: parton-hadron duality (PHD)
nodes.def: A principle of pQCD in which the parton-level predictions of energy-flow are assumed to be similar to the energy-flow at hadron-level. % Not to be confused with PhD (Doctor of Philosophy)

nodes.name: local parton-hadron duality (LPHD)
nodes.def: A refinement of the principle of PHD in which the energy flow of partons at high energies is closely related to the energy flow of final-state hadrons, See preconfinement

nodes.name: parton shower
nodes.def: Any probabilistic algorithm that applies the principles of partonic cascade to produce final-state particles given an initial set of particles

nodes.name: pileup (PU)
nodes.def: Contaminating radiation within a high-energy particle event (especially proton-proton collisions) due to lower-energy scatterings of nearby protons soon before or after a high-energy scattering

nodes.name: mitigation
nodes.def: Techniques for removing the contaminating radiation of pileup radiation
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: pileup-subtracted event
nodes.def: An event with pileup after a pileup mitigation technique has been used to remove pileup

nodes.name: Pythia
nodes.def: A software package which includes automated event generation and hadronization toolkits to aid modern particle physics analyses

nodes.name: Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD)
nodes.def: The theory of the strong nuclear force, written in terms of quarks and gluons

nodes.name: perturbative QCD (pQCD)
nodes.def: QCD in the high-energy regime as approximated through perturbative calculations expressed as power series in the strong coupling

nodes.name: Quantum Field Theory (QFT)
nodes.def: A rich and beautiful unifying language for modern physics which expresses the interactions of our universe in terms of quantum fields

nodes.name: radiator
nodes.def: A function which expresses the fixed-order or resummed properties of a particular observable

nodes.name: recombination scheme
nodes.def: A prescription which determines the intrinsic properties associated with a jet, such as its energy or momentum.

nodes.name: E-Scheme
nodes.def: A recombination scheme in which the four-momentum of a jet is simply defined as the sum of the momenta of its constituents

nodes.name: Winner-Take-All (WTA) Scheme
nodes.def: An iterative recombination scheme in which

nodes.name: re-clustering
nodes.def: A scheme for expressing the constituents of an existing jet as a series of branchings (often ordered by angle)

nodes.name: regularization
nodes.def: A technique for providing physically-sensible, finite results in the presence of potentially infinite quantities in the intermediate steps of a calculation

nodes.name: renormalization
nodes.def: The study of how the properties of a physical system change as a function of scale/magnification

nodes.name: resummation
nodes.def: A mathematical technique for obtaining an analytic result from an infinite series

nodes.name: scattering
nodes.def: A framework for studying the universe which involves slamming objects together, and often involves the study of cross sections

nodes.name: SCET
nodes.def: An effective field theory of QCD which isolates soft and collinear degrees of freedom

nodes.name: soft distortion
nodes.def: A type of low-energy pollution, including hadronization and detector effects, which slightly adjusts the energies and momenta of particles, jets, and subjets

nodes.name: soft limit
nodes.def: A limit in which a single particle in a scattering process has very small energy, with universal features described by soft theorems (e.g. soft photon or gluon theorems)

nodes.name: partonic splitting
nodes.def: The splitting of a parent parton into partonic children, especially in a parton shower

nodes.name: branch of
nodes.def: A child of the splitting of an off-shell parton. % See also emission

nodes.name: tree of partonic splittings
nodes.def: The complete history of splittings of a parent parton in pQCD; % sometimes called the branching history. % See also clustering history

nodes.name: Standard Model of particle physics
nodes.def: A quantum field theory, composed of Quantum Chromodynamics and the unified Electroweak theory, which describes the known matter and interactions of our universe (excluding dark matter, dark energy, and gravity)

nodes.name: sum rule
nodes.def: A constraint on a function or quantity expressed in terms of its integral or summation properties

nodes.name: underlying event (UE)
nodes.def: A phenomenon in collisions of composite particles, in which high-energy events and jets are accompanied by a bath of relatively low-energy particles

nodes.name: UE-corrected distribution
nodes.def: A distribution of a collider observable evaluated on particle events in the presence of UE, after the use of techniques to correct for/mitigate UE effects
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: veto
nodes.home: Pileup and Infrared Radiation Annihilation (PIRANHA): a Paradigm for Continuous Jet Grooming

nodes.name: algorithm
nodes.def: An algorithm for using random numbers to sample from an exponential distribution; % essential for parton shower algorithms

nodes.name: region
nodes.def: A region in which no emission may lie if a jet is to exhibit certain properties, useful in the calculation of resummed jet substructure observables. % See also radiator

nodes.name: yukawa couplings
nodes.home: The Second Higgs at the Lifetime Frontier
